Name: Suguru Geto NPC (Jujutsu Kaisen)
Author: kryptonimus
Description:
[b]DISCLAIMER; I am (by no means) a professional - if there are mistakes please contact me!!! (╥﹏╥)[/b]

[size=2]Hello!! This is my [/size][i]first [/i][size=2]ever mod, I have literally no experience with modding/coding before this and picked this up as a fun project![/size]
[size=3]
NOTES: Sorry for the long wait before an update - I had to recode the whole mod to update the format from 1.30.0 (which was causing issues) to the new 2.0.0 format! If there's any issues please lmk!! [/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W4lVEIj.png[/img]
[b][i]ADDS SUGURU GETO FROM JUJUTSU KAISEN!![/i][/b]
﻿
[size=2]Suguru is [/size][b]marriable[/b][size=2], however I have not tested if you can adopt/have children with him
[list]
[*]IS COMPATIBLE WITH [b]SATORU NPC MOD [/b]
[*]Can be asked as a [b]Flower Dance Partner [/b](may only be when romanced... try regardless haha)
[*]Present in festivals (as far as I'm aware)
[*]His birthday is [b]Fall 3rd[/b]
[*][b]UPDATE: HE HAS 3 NEW HEART EVENTS + ANIMATIONs[/b]
[/list][/size][size=3]
THINGS I HAVE NOT CHECKED FOR (yet...)[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Schedule conflicts[/size]
[*][size=2]Overlapping[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/57JW4Rq.png[/img]

3.0.0 - Adds 3 more new events, spouse room and patio + minor bug fixes!
2.0.2 - Minor bug fixes - no longer stands on Gojo in town on Tuesday
2.0.1 - Little dialogue tweaks for marriage & general dialogue﻿
2.0.0 - Adds 3 new heart events + idle animations!
[/size]1.0.0 - Upload
